meta.title: AI-Driven Smart Energy Management System for Polar Research Stations
meta.department: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR)
meta.official_description: Develop an intelligent energy-management system using AI for load forecasting, renewable energy integration and fuel optimization under extreme polar conditions.
meta.note: Every numeric parameter below carries source + confidence + sensitivity range. The dashboard Assumptions tab is generated from this file. Do not edit a value without editing its source.

blizzard.label: Four-day blizzard: no solar, turbines cut out, heat demand up

genset_failure.label: Primary genset unavailable for 48 h in deep winter

forecast_bust.label: 12 h badly wrong forecast, truth unchanged
